control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - chemical exposure at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4102, PT-4102 and TK-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during routine operation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 April 2020 a potential incident was recorded on P-4102, PT-4102 and TK-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
